pitch.en: Watch videos with friends, in sync, in a real mpv player.

description.en:
I made this app because I'd had it with Syncplay: two windows, underwhelming sync and ready logic, everyone needing their own copy of the file, and switching every video by hand. Discord streaming is convenient, but it's built for live streams. One person's connection drops and the video cuts out, and the quality drops along with it.

In Starsync everyone gets the original file, so the quality is the same for the whole group. It rides out internet drops for as long as there's buffer, and whether the server or a viewer drops, both recover smoothly without getting in the way of the video. The sync is instant, and it often feels like nobody is on the other end at all.

Anyone on the server can open videos from their own Jellyfin for the others to watch, without giving anyone access to their library. Anyone can also put up almost any link from the internet thanks to yt-dlp, or a video straight from their own PC, and only the host ever needs an open port.

Proper Jellyfin integration lets you browse the library with watch tracking on everything. A weekly anime schedule shows exactly when each episode comes out, what's already on Jellyfin and what you've watched, and lets you request new shows from your auto-downloader or Sonarr.
description.ru: Выберите видео из библиотеки Jellyfin, вставьте ссылку или откройте файл с диска: пауза, перемотка и воспроизведение у всех идут вместе. Это приложение для компьютера, а не вкладка браузера: без перекодирования, каждый смотрит оригинал.
